statement:
The collection note lists Dane Rusk as the person collecting.
Collection note CN-31 requested collection by Dane Rusk; however, because a court ruling prohibits Dane Rusk from having contact with Leo Barros and he is not on the approved collection list, authorization was granted instead to his approved grandmother, Ana Barros.
judge_text:
WRONG

It asserts the value is invalid: "a court ruling prohibits Dane Rusk from having contact with Leo Barros and he is not on the approved collection list," and gives the correct collector instead.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
